reason: I want to start making materials for the paintings; plant fiber and water may produce a surface to paint on.
expectation: I expect some kind of paper or pulp, though I’m unsure.

alternatives.reason: Dye and a bowl could prepare paint, but a painting surface seems useful first.

effect: The fiber and water made paper pulp, so I can continue toward a painting surface.
reaction: That result matched my expectation and feels like useful progress.
reason: Combining the pulp with cloth looks like the next step toward making paper.
expectation: I expect a sheet of paper or another prepared painting surface.

alternatives.reason: Preparing dye in the bowl may make paint, but I want to finish the surface first.

effect: The pulp became paper, providing a surface for the paintings.
reason: Dye and a bowl seem likely to prepare paint for the paper.
expectation: I expect paint or a container of prepared dye, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Stone and brick might start the arcade, but I want to prepare the paintings first.

effect: The dye and bowl made paint, so both painting materials are ready.
reaction: The result was predictable and useful.
reason: Paint and paper should make a picture for the arcade.
expectation: I expect a painting or painted paper.

alternatives.reason: Stone and brick might build the arcade, but I want to finish the picture first.

effect: The paint and paper made a picture, so I can turn to building somewhere to display it.
reason: Stone and brick seem useful for constructing the arcade.
expectation: I expect a wall or another part of the arcade, though I’m unsure.

alternatives.reason: Glass and stone might produce material for the mosaic, but I want to work on the arcade first.

effect: Stone and brick made an arch, which looks like part of the arcade.
reaction: The result makes sense for the building.
reason: Adding planks to the arch may provide the arcade's roof.
expectation: I expect a roofed arcade or another part of it.

alternatives.reason: Glass and stone might make mosaic material, but I want to finish the arcade first.

effect: The arch and planks made a roofed arcade, ready to display the picture.
reaction: The roof construction makes sense and matched my expectation.
reason: Combining the picture with the arcade should fulfill the display goal.
expectation: I expect the picture to be hung in the arcade, completing that goal.

alternatives.reason: Glass and stone may help make the mosaic, but the picture and arcade are ready now.

effect: The gallery is complete, leaving the mosaic goal.
reaction: Seeing the picture displayed in the sheltered arcade was satisfying.
reason: Glass and stone may produce pieces for the mosaic.
expectation: I expect glass fragments or mosaic tiles, though I’m unsure.

alternatives.reason: Glass and planks might also help make the mosaic, but stone seems more useful for breaking glass into pieces.

effect: Glass and stone made mosaic pieces, which can now be combined with clay.
reason: Clay may provide a bed for arranging the mosaic pieces.
expectation: I expect a mosaic or a prepared mosaic panel, though I’m unsure.

alternatives.reason: Glass and planks might also contribute, but the mosaic pieces are ready to use.

effect: The mosaic pieces and clay made a mosaic, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: Setting the glass pieces into clay made sense and provided a satisfying finish.

mostWorthwhile.text: Hanging the picture in the sheltered arcade was most worthwhile because the separate materials came together as a public gallery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making paper from pulp was predictable, though it usefully prepared the painting surface.

surprise.text: The arch and planks became a complete arcade; the explanation clarified how the roof covered the walkway.

arbitrary.text: Using cloth with paper pulp to make paper felt less clear than the other combinations; I followed the offered option without knowing its role.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see what the settlement makes next, though this chapter's combinations were mostly predictable.
